grades: High school teens for the Teen Advisory Board
duration: Teen volunteer hours are not stated. Internships run fall, spring and summer.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens get service hours for volunteering. Internships are non-paid.
name: Teen Volunteers, Internships and Teen Advisory Board
org: Alive Center (Naperville, Aurora and Hanover Park)
city: Naperville, Aurora and Hanover Park, IL
what_you_do: Mentor and tutor younger teens after school. Help with events or join the Teen Advisory Board. Unpaid internships are offered. Fields include marketing, graphic design and fundraising. Others are mentoring, IT and social media.
who_can_apply: Teens can volunteer. The internship page gives no age or school rule and lists colleges, so ask if high schoolers can intern.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board: new high school members are picked each April. Volunteering and internships have no deadline stated.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application. Then meet a staff member for an interview and training. Interns use a different form. Teen Advisory Board members use their own form.
notes: Alive says it runs free drop-in hours after school and over the summer, plus teen-led clubs. Locations named on the site are Naperville, Aurora and Hanover Park. The internship page lists college affiliated schools, so ask about high school interns.
